The '''Thustra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]].
